'''Razor grass''', also known as '''razorgrass''', was a troublesome [[Plant/Legends|plant]] that grew wild on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]],<ref name="SoF" /> [[Togoria/Legends|Togoria]],<ref name="CRO">''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]''</ref> and [[Relkass]].<ref name="Creatures">''[[Creatures of the Galaxy]]''</ref> Blades of razor grass appeared smooth and felt smooth to the touch, but were lined with microscopic "blades" that could slice easily through cloth and flesh. The blades were so fine that razor grass was as painless as it was deadly. One might brush up against it and not notice the [[Blood/Legends|bleeding]] for several minutes. The grass had no effect on [[Duraplast/Legends|duraplast]] or reinforced building materials, but was known to leave ugly scratches on speeders made of cheap metal.
